user.title: Set up VOICEVOX TTS
user.description: Please enter the host and port of the server running the VOICEVOX Engine.

speaker_selection.title: Select a voice
speaker_selection.description: Choose the voice for VOICEVOX TTS.

data_description.volume: Setting a high volume may cause sound cracking or damage to your audio device. It is recommended to use a high volume only if the volume is insufficient with the pitch changed.
data_description.use_streaming: When running a version of the VOICEVOX Engine that supports streaming talk, audio streaming starts playback before audio generation is complete. Turn this off if audio playback is interrupted.
data_description.process_text_incrementally: Split streaming text responses from Assist and similar sources at punctuation and send them to the VOICEVOX Engine to start speaking sooner. Synthesizing separate text segments may produce unnatural pauses or intonation, and processing speed may cause gaps between audio segments.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure VOICEVOX TTS
reconfigure.description: Update the host and port settings.

error.timeout: Connection timed out. Please make sure your configuration is correct.
error.error: Unable to connect. Please make sure that the host and port are correct.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the log for details.
error.speaker_fetch_failed: Failed to fetch voice information. Please check your connection.
